notes.title: Card Trading Event
notes.content:
🃏 Card Trading Event! 🃏

Calling all collectors and traders! From June 13th at 17:00 CEST, you’ll be able to trade all cards from common up to epic freely with anyone in the community!  


🤝 Trade Without Limits
No restrictions, no barriers—just pure trading fun!
Whether you want to grow your collection, help a friend, or clean up your duplicates, this is your chance to make the most of your collection.


🌍 Time Zones
Starts: June 13th at 17:00 CEST (08:00 PDT / 11:00 EDT / 23:00 CST / 00:00 JST – June 14)

Ends: In 2-3 weeks.  
💬 Don't forget:
You can find trading partners in our official Discord channel (linked in-game). It’s the best place to connect, trade, and chat!

notes.title: Common Card Trading Week!
notes.content:
🃏 Common Card Trading Week is Here! 🃏

Calling all collectors and traders!
From May 10th at 17:00 CEST to May 17th at 17:00 CEST, you’ll be able to trade all common cards freely with anyone in the community!

🤝 Trade Without Limits
No restrictions, no barriers—just pure trading fun!
Whether you want to grow your collection, help a friend, or clean up your duplicates, this is your chance to make the most of your collection.

🌍 Time Zones
Starts: May 10th at 17:00 CEST
(08:00 PDT / 11:00 EDT / 23:00 CST / 00:00 JST – May 11)

notes.title: Launch Bonus: Drop Rates Increased!
notes.content:
To celebrate the launch, drop rates have been boosted from May 2nd at 17:00 CEST (08:00 PDT / 11:00 EDT / 23:00 CST / 00:00 JST) until May 9th at the same time.

New Drop Rates

Common: [strike]70%[/strike] ➜ 60%
Uncommon: [strike]20.71%[/strike] ➜ 25%
Rare: [strike]8.28%[/strike] ➜ 10%
Epic: [strike]1%[/strike] ➜ 4.8%
